notes:
Artist biographies, and a fix for something that would have stopped the app reaching a phone at all.

WHO IS THIS. Open an artist in Discover and you now get their story - where they came from, who they played with, what they are known for. It sits under their photograph, four lines at first, with More to read the rest.

IT WORKS FOR YOUR OWN MUSIC TOO, or it will. The biography is attached to the ARTIST rather than to Apple Music, so the same one will serve a record on your NAS, an Apple Music album, and whatever streaming service comes next. Apple's own service turned out not to supply biographies at all - the field exists and is always empty, on a subscription and without one - so these come from elsewhere and are the better for it.

IT REMEMBERS THE GOOD ONES. A biography is fetched once and kept. If the best source happens to be unreachable at that moment, Sorriva will show what it can find but deliberately does NOT save it - so the next time you open that artist it tries again and replaces it with something better. A bad moment never becomes that artist's permanent biography.

A BUG YOU COULD NOT HAVE SEEN, and the more important half of this release. The previous version carried a setting that made the app impossible to install on a real iPhone - it only ever worked in the simulator, where that setting is not checked. Anything built for a device, for TestFlight or for the App Store would have failed. Removed, and installing on a real phone is verified working again.

ALSO. The artist biography reads properly rather than showing the reference codes its source stores it with. Collapsing a long biography now returns you to where you were reading instead of stranding you further down the page.

NOT IN THIS RELEASE. Your own artists in the Library still have no page to show a biography on - tapping an artist goes straight to their albums. That screen is next.
